save_comparison_html: save comparison HTML with true and predicted DoclingDocument side by side on a single page with embedded page image
save_comparison_html_with_clusters: save comparison HTML with document layout clusters and reading order arrows drawn on both true and predicted page images
save_inspection_html: save inspection HTML with per-page annotated images showing clusters and reading order for a DoclingDocument
draw_clusters_with_reading_order: draw clusters with bounding boxes, labels, and optional reading order arrows on a page image from a DoclingDocument
draw_arrow: draw a red arrow with arrowhead on an ImageDraw object between two coordinate points
